parrafo_1.es: La Plaza Bakery And Coffee es una panadería y cafetería familiar de estilo argentino en North Miami, FL, con pastelería, empanadas y tortas frescas todos los días.
parrafo_1.en: La Plaza Bakery And Coffee is a family-style Argentine bakery and cafe in North Miami, FL, with fresh pastries, empanadas and cakes baked every day.

parrafo_2.es: 431 reseñas en Google respaldan una calificación de 4.7: ingredientes frescos, atención amable y tortas a pedido, incluso con poco aviso.
parrafo_2.en: 431 reviews on Google back a 4.7 rating: fresh ingredients, friendly service and cakes made to order, even on short notice.

texto.es: Pregunta por lo de hoy, las empanadas o una torta para tu evento.
texto.en: Ask about today's pastries, empanadas or a custom cake for your event.

texto.es: Desde facturas y empanadas hasta una torta personalizada, te decimos qué hay listo y qué necesita más tiempo.
texto.en: From facturas and empanadas to a full custom cake, we tell you what's ready now and what needs lead time.

texto.es: Todo se hornea en el local, la misma calidad por la que nuestros clientes regresan cada semana.
texto.en: Everything is baked in house, the same quality our regulars come back for every week.

texto.es: Pasa por North Miami a retirar tu pedido, con café caliente incluido si quieres quedarte un rato.
texto.en: Stop by North Miami to pick up your order, hot coffee included if you want to stay a while.

nota.es: Cada pedido se hornea fresco; pregunta por tortas personalizadas para cualquier ocasión.
nota.en: Every order is baked fresh; ask about custom cakes for any occasion.

texto.es: Facturas, medialunas y hojaldres clásicos horneados frescos cada mañana.
texto.en: Facturas, medialunas and classic puff pastries baked fresh every morning.

texto.es: Tortas de cumpleaños y celebraciones hechas frescas, incluso con poco aviso.
texto.en: Birthday and celebration cakes made fresh, even on short notice.

texto.es: Empanadas y un menú de almuerzo diario para comer rápido y con sabor auténtico.
texto.en: Empanadas and a daily lunch menu for a quick, authentic bite.

texto.es: Café con leche y desayuno completo para un verdadero brunch argentino.
texto.en: Cafe con leche and a full breakfast spread for a proper Argentine brunch.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que buscas? Llámanos y te confirmamos si lo tenemos.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you want? Call us and we will confirm if we have it.

items.quote: The best brunch that I have. The service was amazing. I ask questions about the pastries and they was answered very well. Everything was fresh, delicious and I will recommend to everyone that can be able to go. I love it.

Absolutely love this place. The food, the staff, and everything they sell are outstanding. They made me the best birthday cake I’ve had in 20 years, on short notice, and it was perfect. We come here every week for fresh pastries and …

What a wonderful experience! This Argentine bakery is a true gem. Everything is fresh, authentic, and absolutely delicious. From the pastries and facturas to the empanadas and cakes, every item is made with exceptional quality and care. …
